&variables;
What is the current version? Steps to retrieve the current version of the UKO database
Retrieve current version SQL Queries the EKMF_META content from the Db2 database and puts the result in a temp file $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_DB} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_DB}
Submit jcl to execute step 1 true
jcl/get-database-version.jcl JCL 80
Create variable name for the version Retrieves the version from the previous SQL query and puts the result in a variable $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_ZFS} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_ZFS} Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
currentversion=$(sed -E -e 's/ *//g' -e 's/.*1_\|([A-Z0-9]*).*/\1/' ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.version); echo "Current database version is: ${currentversion}";
echo "UKO_DB_VERSION ${currentversion}" >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties
chmod 644 ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties
shell-JCL ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.properties
Update the database to V2R1Mx Update the UKO database to V2R1Mx
Create DDL from files (Legacy) Create the DDL to be executed from files delivered by EKMF Web V2 $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_ZFS} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_ZFS}
Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
currentversion=${instance-UKO_DB_VERSION}; echo "Current database version is: $currentversion";
cd ${instance-DB_FILE_INSTALL_PATH}/resources/db_definitions;
# retrieve the numbers from the codepage to select the correct sub folder subfolder=$(echo ${instance-DB_CODEPAGE} | sed -E 's/[^[:digit:]]*([:digit:]*)/\1/' ) cd ${subfolder};
# replacing the default values in the ddls sedstring="s/DKMGWEB/${instance-DB_NAME_UKO}/g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s/DKMGPE1/${instance-DB_NAME_DATASET_ENCRYPTION_STATUS}/g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s/BP8K0/${instance-DB_BUFFERPOOL_TABLESPACE_8K}/g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s/BP32K/${instance-DB_BUFFERPOOL_TABLESPACE_32K}/g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s/GKMG0001/${instance-DB_STOGROUP}/g"
tempversion=$currentversion; echo "SET CURRENT SQLID = '${instance-DB_CURRENT_SQLID}' ;" > ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.ddl; echo "SET CURRENT SCHEMA = '${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA}' ;" >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.ddl; for i in `ls *.ddl | xargs echo`; do tempversion=$(echo $i | cut -c 1-6); if [[ "$currentversion" < "$tempversion" ]]; then echo "DDL added to list of updates: $i" sed -e "$sedstring" $i >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.ddl echo "COMMIT;" >> ${instance-TEMP_DIR}/zosmf-${_workflow-workflowKey}.ddl; fi done; echo "Database will be updated to: $tempversion"
shell-JCL
Execute DDL to update to V2R1Mx Execute the list of DDLs that have ben created before $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_DB} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_DB}
Submit jcl to execute step 1 true
jcl/update-database.jcl JCL 80
Configure Access to the Db2 database Configure the new UKO server to be able to access the required tables
Configure db access for the server Configure the new UKO server to be able to access the required tables $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_DB} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_DB}
Submit jcl to execute step 1 true
jcl/database-grant-access.jcl JCL 80
